messages:
Lena M: Quick QA request  PR to update function-calling docs to the structured-output schema is up. Need a quick look at the parse-fallback wording and a tiny malformed-json example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4722 :wave:
Tom B: On it. Do we have guidance for partially malformed JSON (e.g., trailing commas) vs totally invalid?
Lena M: I added a short strategy: try JSON.parse -> if it throws, fall back to `raw_text` field and surface a parsing warning in the SDK. Example snippet in the PR.
Ivy C: Suggestion: show a minimal defensive accessor for SDKs so authors copy-paste safe code.
Tom B: small example I like:
```js
let parsed;
try { parsed = JSON.parse(text); }
catch(e) { parsed = { raw_text: text }; }
const out = parsed.toolOutput ?? parsed.tool_result ?? { raw_text: text };
```
Lena M: Added that exact snippet to the PR. Also added a one-line migration anchor for backwards compat: `const out = res.toolOutput ?? res.tool_result;`
ci-link-bot: Link check failed: https://docs.redwood.ai/specs/old-tool-schema -> 404
Lena M: Thanks bot. Replaced the dead link with canonical schema: https://docs.redwood.ai/schemas/structured-output-2025.json and pushed.
Ivy C: Under Guardrails please call out recommended routing fields: `request_id` (string) and `confidence` (number 0..1). Mention it's strongly recommended but not enforced.
eng-runtime-bot: Runtime note: `confidence` semantics = 0..1 float. Confirmed.
Tom B: One more nit: show union-array example (choices[] OR error string). I added a tiny validator pseudo-code in the PR: `if (!Array.isArray(res.choices)) { handleError(res.error || res.raw_text) }`.
Lena M: Great. I also added an `example_response` block for typegen consumers.
Ivy C: LGTY other than a phrasing nit. I'll approve after CI link checks pass.
ci-link-bot: Link check passed for updated URLs.
Lena M: Thanks all. I'll merge after the approval. If anyone wants to add an edge-case (nullable arrays, empty choices) post here and I'll fold it in before the merge. :thumbsup:
